Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Dezvoltare de software
We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer (Java | Angular | Spring Boot | Azure) to join our Global Warehouse Management transformation program. The ideal candidate has strong experience in full-stack software development, combining expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, TypeScript, and REST APIs, with the ability to design, develop, and support enterprise-grade applications.
 The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering end-to-end software solutions, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and contributing to the development of a global platform used across multiple regions. Following the platform go-live, the role will also support complex troubleshooting and application support activities, ensuring platform stability and continuous improvement.
 Responsibilities: 
Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise applications across frontend and backend layers.
Develop scalable and maintainable solutions using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and TypeScript. 
Build and consume RESTful APIs and integrate applications with internal and external systems.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Business Analysts, QA Engineers, and DevOps teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions.
Perform code reviews and promote development best practices and coding standards.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across applications, integrations, and databases.
Support production environments through root cause analysis and issue resolution.
Contribute to application performance optimization, scalability improvements, and platform reliability.
Create and maintain technical documentation.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and technical workshops.
Mentor less experienced developers and provide technical guidance within the team.
Collaborate with global teams and stakeholders across multiple business units and locations.
Support continuous improvement initiatives within development and delivery processes.
 Requirements: 
 8+ years of professional experience in Software Development .
Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot.
Strong hands-on experience with Angular and TypeScript.
Experience developing and consuming REST APIs and web services.
Experience building and supporting enterprise-grade applications.
Strong understanding of software development principles, design patterns, and application architecture.
Experience working with SQL and/or NoSQL databases.
Experience working within Agile development environments.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional and international teams.
Ability to work independently while taking ownership of development deliverables.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Professional English communication skills.
 Willingness and ability to work aligned with US business hours from February 2027 onwards. 
 Nice to have: 
Experience with Azure Cloud services and cloud-native applications.
Experience with Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
Experience with L2/L3 application support.
Knowledge of monitoring, logging, and performance analysis tools.
Experience with enterprise integrations and distributed systems.
Experience working on global transformation program.
Knowledge of Supply Chain, Logistics, or Warehouse Management processes.
Experience working in large enterprise environments and international projects.
 About Computacenter 
 Computacenter is a leading independent technology and services provider, trusted by large corporate and public sector organizations. We are a responsible business that believes in sustainable long-term value creation. 
 We help our customers to source, transform and manage their technology infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling people and their businesses. 
 Computacenter plc is a public company quoted on the London Stock Exchange (CCC.L) and a member of the FTSE 100. Computacenter employs over 21,000 people worldwide.
